title: Evolutionary Computation: A Paradigm of Natural Generative AI and Creative Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2510.08590v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative AI relies on statistical learning and local gradient-based guidance, often resulting in artifacts that may be more emulative than genuinely creative. This position paper advances a perspective on Evolutionary Computation (EC) as a paradigm of Natural Generative AI (NGAI), in which stochastic variation, diversification, and natural selection present an alternative foundation for generative exploration and creative synthesis. EC provides an array of variation operators with varied generative capabilities: parent-centric operators induce population distributions analogous to conventional generative models, while disruptive operators can produce structured evolutionary leaps to out-of-distribution artifacts (e.g., programs, designs, or AI agents themselves). translated_title: 演化计算：自然生成式AI与创造性合成的范式
translated_abstract: 生成式AI依赖于统计学习和基于梯度的局部引导，其产生的结果往往更倾向于模仿而非真正的创造性。这篇立场论文提出了将演化计算（EC）视为自然生成式AI（NGAI）范式的观点，其中随机变异、多样化和自然选择为生成式探索和创造性合成提供了另一种基础。EC提供了多种具有不同生成能力的变异算子：以父代为中心的算子可诱导出与传统生成模型类似的种群分布，而破坏性算子则能够产生结构化的演化跃迁，生成分布之外的产物（如程序、设计或AI智能体本身）。这一视角揭示了多任务EC中某些破坏性变异与分布乘积种群结构之间独特的理论关联。一种数学……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出演化计算（EC）可作为“自然生成式AI”（NGAI）的新范式，其随机变异与自然选择机制能够突破传统统计学习的模仿局限，实现真正的创造性合成与分布外的演化跃迁。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Evolutionary Computation (EC) as a paradigm of Natural Generative AI (NGAI), where stochastic variation and natural selection provide an alternative foundation for genuine creative synthesis and out-of-distribution evolutionary leaps beyond conventional statistical learning.
